messages:
sara: quick midweek check — can folks drop short status + blockers for the performance sprint? specifically: kernel PRs, continuous-batching rollout, and KV cache eviction tuning. goal: list owners, any regressions, and any reviewers we need to ping.

alok: kernel PR #412 merged to staging at sha a3f9b2c — microbatch path switch + new attention kernel. perf bench shows +9% throughput on gpu-a, but 95p latency up ~6ms on short seqs. still investigating. tagging @mike for latency look.

mike: saw that — running lightweight reproducer now. early guess: kernel introduced a small memcpy on hot path for seq_len<=32. I added a comment in the PR and opened follow-up fix branch kernel/avoid-copy-32. will try to test perf impact by EOD.

cheng: KV cache eviction patch (kv/evict-heuristic v2) is ready for review, diff: ```git diff --staged -- kv/evict.go``` — it changes eviction scoring to favor recent prefixes. local e2e looks good (cache hit +12%), but we need more load testing against steady-state requests. requesting @reena for load harness runs.

reena: can run the harness tomorrow 9am PT. quick note: when we did earlier kv tweaks, we saw a spike in mem usage on a few hosts — want to watch OOM guardrails. I'll run mem + throughput matrix and post results.

alok: dependency flag — kernel PR depends on libcuda bump in infra; infra team scheduled bump in staging this afternoon. if bump slips, kernel PR can't go to canary.

infra-bot: deploy status: infra/libcuda bump -> staging started (job: deploy-789). ETA ~25m. (job link: https://ci.redwood/api/jobs/789) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: if infra bump completes, I'll run the short-seq latency test plan: `scripts/perf/run_short_seq.sh --runs 50` and post numbers. if latency regression persists, we can gate kernel change behind runtime flag `--enable-new-attn` for controlled rollout.

cheng: +1 to feature flag. also canary suggestion: route 10% of requests to new kernel + kv improvements together to check interactions. we've seen corner-case regressions when both land separately.

reena: for canary, I'll prepare traffic mix: 60% long-chat, 30% short-seq, 10% embeddings. that'll exercise both KV and batching behavior. posting load plan in a follow-up thread.

alok: owners/PRs to watch: kernel #412 (me), kernel/avoid-copy-32 (mike), kv/evict-heuristic (cheng). reviewers: @mike, @cheng, @sara.

sara: outstanding reviewers — can each reviewer ack rough ETA? we need to coordinate for a single canary window tomorrow afternoon.

mike: review + test by 5pm PT today. if I hit a blocker I'll ping here.

cheng: review pinged @sara, aiming EOD.

reena: load tests scheduled 9am PT tomorrow, canary window 2pm-4pm PT. I'll post acceptance criteria (throughput, 95p latency delta < +10ms, mem stable).

sara: blockers captured: infra bump (in progress), potential memcpy regression (mike), mem spike risk on kv change (reena). next steps: mike finish microcopy fix, cheng and reena coordinate load tests, infra-bot update on bump. i'll compile a short rollout checklist and post in #eng-releases. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alok: one more note — code-review queue: please prioritize kernel/avoid-copy-32 since it's small and critical for latency. tagging @mike again.

mike: on it. will request review when tests pass.

sara: if anything urgent pops up, drop an update here; otherwise i'll assume the timeline above. thanks!

infra-bot: deploy status: infra/libcuda bump -> staging succeeded (job: deploy-789) :white_check_mark:

mike: re-running short-seq perf now.

mike: results: throughput unchanged, 95p latency back down to baseline (within +1ms). microcopy fix looks good. will open PR later today.

reena: note from local load runs: kv/evict-heuristic v2 increased hit rate but memory high-water mark went up ~8% on worker-3. i'll add guardrail to eviction to clamp memory under HWM and retest.

cheng: thanks — i'll incorporate clamp and push update to PR.

sara: great progress. closing the loop: will post final canary checklist and times in #eng-releases; please copy any follow-ups into this thread. :star:
